description: Runs a cargo binary and returns structured output (exit code, stdout, stderr).

args.description: Arguments to pass to the binary (after --)

bin.description: Name of the binary to run (--bin <NAME>) for multi-binary crates

example.description: Name of the example to run (--example <NAME>)

features.description: Space or comma separated list of features to activate (--features)

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

maxOutputSize.description: Maximum size in bytes for stdout/stderr before truncation. Default: 1048576 (1MB). Min: 1024, Max: 10485760 (10MB).

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default feature (--no-default-features)

package.description: Package to run in a workspace

timeout.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds. Overrides the default 300s. Min: 1000 (1s), Max: 600000 (10m).

name: run

failureType.description: Type of failure: compilation (rustc error), runtime (program error), or timeout

title: Cargo Run
